snippet.title: Fable - Official Combat Gameplay | gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
In Fable, you’ll flow seamlessly between melee, ranged, and magical abilities as you come face-to-face with classic creatures and new threats lurking across Albion.

Experiment with different loadouts, discover powerful spell combinations, and choose the combat style that feels right for you as you carve your own path through Albion.

Fable launches February 23, 2027. Pre-Order to receive the Pre-Order Content Pack, featuring the questionably heroic Chicken Suit and a collection of charming in-game gifts. You'll get up to 5 days Early Access with the Premium Edition: http://fablethegame.com
